# Core

Source: [`Kernel/Core.wl`](../../Kernel/Core.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#core-kernelcorewl)

assertions, exact zero tests, stage bookkeeping, summary cards, scal. Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Core".

## Symbols

### `FRGAssert`

`FRGAssert[name, cond, details, hint]` returns name if cond is True; otherwise prints a red FAIL block (check, module, short offending expression, hint), sets \$FRGLastFailure = name and aborts (`Exit[2]` in a math -script run).

### `$FRGLastFailure`

\$FRGLastFailure is the name of the last check that failed (diagnostic only).

### `$FRGModule`

\$FRGModule is the module name printed in FAIL blocks (set with Block by each constructor).

### `$FRGExitOnFail`

\$FRGExitOnFail: if True a failed check calls `Exit[2]` instead of `Abort[]` (default: True in math -script runs).

### `ExactlyZeroQ`

`ExactlyZeroQ[expr]` is True iff expr vanishes exactly at several random rational points: every non-System symbol (couplings, q, k, Dim, ...) gets an independent random rational, and every remaining function atom `r[y]`, r'\[y\], r''\[y\], `f[...]`, `f[a][y]`, `Derivative[k][f[a]][y]` (as a whole) gets its own independent random rational (same atom, same value). Option "Seeds" -> {1, 2, 3}.

### `RandomRationalPoint`

`RandomRationalPoint[syms, seed]` gives rules sym -> random rational in (0, 1), reproducible from seed.

### `PrintCard`

`PrintCard[stage]` prints the stage summary card: PASS/WARN/INFO/ASSUMPTION lines, LeafCount, timing, fingerprint.

### `scal`

`scal[a, b]` is the scalar product of the vectors a, b (bare symbols). Orderless; linear over sums and over explicit numbers only (not over couplings).

### `wedge`

`wedge[a, b]` = eps\_ij a\_i b\_j (d = 2, eps\_12 = +1) of the vectors a, b (bare symbols). Antisymmetric (canonical order, not Orderless), `wedge[a, a]` = 0; linear over sums and over explicit numbers only.

## Internal symbols

Shared between modules; not on the user's context path.

### `assertCheck`

`assertCheck[name, cond, details, hint, summary]` runs FRGAssert and returns a check record for a stage card.

### `infoCheck`

`infoCheck[status, name, summary]` is a non-failing card line ("WARN", "INFO", "ASSUMPTION").

### `stampStage`

`stampStage[assoc]` adds the "Fingerprint" key (hash of the stage content).

### `validateStage`

`validateStage[stage, name]` asserts the stage key and fingerprint of an upstream stage.

### `reservedNames`

reservedNames: symbol names the user may not use for fields or couplings.

### `assertFreshSymbols`

`assertFreshSymbols[check, syms, what]` asserts that user symbols are usable as fields / couplings.

### `inputForm`

`inputForm[e, n]` is a short one-line InputForm string of e.

### `displayString`

`displayString[e]` is a full one-line InputForm string of e without package contexts; `scal[a, a]` -> a^2, `scal[a, b]` -> a.b, `wedge[a, b]` -> wedge(a,b).

### `reduceWedge2D`

`reduceWedge2D[e]` rewrites every product of two wedges by the d = 2 identity `wedge[a,b]` `wedge[c,d]` = `scal[a,c]` `scal[b,d]` - `scal[a,d]` `scal[b,c]` until each term of the expanded e has at most one wedge.
